title: Resetting your password
intro: If you cannot remember your CropWatch password, you can set a new one yourself from the sign-in page. It takes a few minutes and needs only access to the email inbox you sign in with.

content.text: CropWatch sends the reset link to the email address on your account, so you need to be able to open that inbox. If the address belongs to a colleague or to someone who has left, ask your company's CropWatch administrator or CropWatch support for help instead.
There is no "change password" setting inside CropWatch. If you know your current password and simply want a new one, sign out and follow the same steps below.

sections.heading: Open the Forgot your password page

content.text: Go to the CropWatch sign-in page. Under the
Sign in
button there are two buttons side by side. Press the one on the right,
Forgot your password?
You do not need to fill in the email and password boxes on this page first.

image.alt: The CropWatch sign-in page, with the Forgot your password? button under the Sign in button highlighted
image.caption: Forgot your password? is the right-hand button under Sign in.

content.text: Type the email address you sign in with into the
EMAIL
box, then press
Send Reset Link
If a red message says
Security verification failed. Please try again.
, the page's reCAPTCHA check did not pass. Reload the page and try once more. If you see
Unable to sign in right now. Please try again.
, you most likely asked for two links within a minute; wait a minute and press the button again.

image.alt: The Forgot your password? page with an email address typed in the EMAIL box and the Send Reset Link button highlighted
image.caption: Enter the address you sign in with, then press Send Reset Link.

content.text: The page changes to
Check Your Email

. It says the same thing whether or not an account exists for that address; CropWatch does this on purpose so nobody can use the page to find out who has an account. Seeing this page does not confirm that you typed the address correctly.
Look for an email from CropWatch with the password reset link. It usually arrives within a few minutes. If it is not in your inbox, check the spam or junk folder.
Use the newest email.
Each time you press Send Reset Link, the new link replaces the one before it. If you asked more than once, only the most recent email works, and each link works only once.

image.alt: The Check Your Email page, saying that a password reset link has been sent if an account exists with that email, with a Back to Login button
image.caption: This page looks the same whether or not the address has an account.

sections.heading: Open the link in the email

content.text: Press the link in the email. It opens a CropWatch page titled
Set New Password
in your browser, with two empty boxes:
PASSWORD
and
CONFIRM PASSWORD
You have 10 minutes from pressing the link to pressing Update Password, and you must finish in the same browser window the link opened. If you run out of time, ask for a new link.

image.alt: The Set New Password page with empty PASSWORD and CONFIRM PASSWORD boxes and a greyed-out Update Password button
image.caption: The page the email link opens.

content.text: Type your new password into
PASSWORD
. A list of requirements appears underneath, and each line turns from red to green once your password meets it. The password needs all five:
In the picture, the password so far has letters but no number or symbol, so those two lines are still red.

image.alt: The Set New Password page with a password typed in. Under it, the requirements list shows the length, lowercase and uppercase lines in green and the number and symbol lines in red
image.caption: Red lines are the requirements still missing.

content.text: Type the same password again into
CONFIRM PASSWORD
. When the two match,
✓ Passwords match
appears in green. The
Update Password
button stays greyed out until every requirement is green and both boxes match.
Press
Update Password
. CropWatch takes you back to the sign-in page. Sign in with your email address and the new password.
If your browser or a password manager saved your old password, update the saved entry now so it does not fill in the old one next time.

image.alt: The Set New Password page with all five requirements green, both boxes filled, the message Passwords match, and the Update Password button highlighted
image.caption: Every line green and Passwords match: Update Password is ready.

content.text: The link opened the sign-in page instead of Set New Password.
The link had already been used, a newer link had replaced it, or it had expired. Go back to
Forgot your password?
and ask for a new one.
"Failed to update password. The link may have expired."
More than 10 minutes passed between opening the link and pressing Update Password. Ask for a new link and set the password straight away.
No email arrived.

Check the spam or junk folder and give it a few more minutes. Then check the address: it must be exactly the one you sign in with, and the Check Your Email page will not tell you if it was wrong. Ask for one more link, and if that one does not arrive either, contact CropWatch support.
The Update Password button stays grey.
One of the requirements is not green yet, or the two boxes do not match. A common miss is the symbol: letters and numbers alone are not enough.
